missing input path with caught BASE lookup error -> E_SOURCE_INPUT_DIGEST
taxonomy direct phase candidate count -> E_TAXONOMY_COVERAGE
source or human evidence replacement -> E_ANALYSIS_EVIDENCE
source line numeric type alias -> E_SOURCE_ANCHOR
legacy upstream negated note `非静的read-only参照のみ` -> E_STATIC_UPSTREAM
